gbm_population_evidence.quote: All Patients must have WHO Grade IV Glioblastoma/Gliosarcoma using WHO 2021 criteria and include the diagnosis of molecular GBM
Patients must be IDH wild type by CLIA-certified laboratory assay available at time of consent.

candidate_evidence.quote: Phase Ib Trial of ABBV-637 or ABBV-155 in Combination With ERAS-801 for Glioblastoma With Amplification of the Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: patients will be randomized to either Cohort A or B if recurrent GBM, and Cohort C or D if newly diagnosed.

role_evidence.quote: will receive ABBV-637 before standard surgery, followed by ABBV-637 and ERAS-801 after standard surgery.
will receive ABBV-637 in combination with standard radiation and chemotherapy drug temozolomide.

agents.drug_class_hint: ABBV-637, investigational intravenous antibody-drug conjugate (believed EGFR-directed)

role_evidence.quote: will receive ABBV-155 before standard surgery, followed by ABBV-155 and ERAS-801 after standard surgery
will receive ABBV-155 in combination with standard radiation and chemotherapy drug temozolomide

agents.drug_class_hint: ABBV-155, investigational intravenous antibody-drug conjugate (believed B7-H3-directed)

role_evidence.quote: Phase Ib Trial of ABBV-637 or ABBV-155 in Combination With ERAS-801 for Glioblastoma With Amplification of the Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor

agents.drug_class_hint: ERAS-801, investigational oral brain-penetrant EGFR inhibitor

role_evidence.quote: will receive ABBV-637 in combination with standard radiation and chemotherapy drug temozolomide.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

source_quote.quote: Patients must have evidence of EGFR gene amplification by CLIA-certified laboratory assay at time of consent.
Patients must be IDH wild type by CLIA-certified laboratory assay available at time of consent.

coder_notes: Roles differ by arm: in Cohorts A/B, ABBV-637 or ABBV-155 is given with ERAS-801 (two investigational agents, experimental_combination); in Cohorts C/D, ABBV-637 or ABBV-155 is the only investigational agent on a temozolomide/radiotherapy backbone (would be experimental_monotherapy there). EGFR amplification is an entry requirement; matched to ERAS-801 (EGFR inhibitor) and likely also ABBV-637 if EGFR-directed; the record itself links EGFR-targeted therapy to 'the investigational regimen' in the exclusion criteria. Window-of-opportunity design (pre-surgical dosing in recurrent cohorts) but no tissue PK or PD outcome is registered, so tumour_pk_planned and target_engagement_planned coded no. Eligibility mentions Cohorts E and F that are not registered arms.
